lines.text: AI and chip stocks lost over $1 trillion in four days.
lines.say: AI and chip stocks lost over one trillion dollars in four days.

lines.text: That's CNBC's count of 20 of the biggest AI and chip stocks, October 12 to 15, 2026.
lines.say: That's CNBC's count of twenty of the biggest AI and chip stocks, October twelfth to fifteenth.

lines.text: Nvidia alone lost about $291 billion, down 5.3%.
lines.say: Nvidia alone lost about two hundred ninety-one billion dollars, down five point three percent.

lines.text: Why? A lot of AI building runs on borrowed money, and hot inflation data revived fears of higher rates.
lines.say: Why? A lot of AI building runs on borrowed money, and hot inflation data revived fears of higher rates.

lines.text: Investors also fretted over data center firm CoreWeave's debt and a possible memory chip glut.
lines.say: Investors also fretted over data center firm CoreWeave's debt and a possible memory chip glut.

lines.text: The chip fund SOXX fell 8 days straight through October 15, down about 12.6%.

20 of the most valuable AI and chip stocks shed $1T+ from Oct 12-15, 2026 (CNBC).
